registration_pins: EXP077-relative filenames -> SHA256 of actual bytes; both static manifests and all declared design/source files included; excludes registration/qualification metadata themselves
qualification_files: EXP077-relative declared design/runner/schema/test filenames -> SHA256; excludes qualification metadata itself
qualification_source_pins: repository-relative reused dependency files -> SHA256; includes exact candidate dependencies and acquisition service/engine/measurement dependencies
dependencies: installed distribution names -> exact versions used in qualification and required at live admission
external_source_pins: optional public source labels -> SHA256/revision for external pinned CLI; no personal paths or deployment endpoints
revision_semantics: registered_source_revision points to the sealed design/source commit before registration metadata; qualified_source_revision points to source including registration before qualification metadata
artifact_commit_verification: registration and qualification metadata bytes verified at current committed HEAD, not their own pointed-to prior source revisions
live_admission: verify committed metadata, all current and prior-commit file pins, exact dependencies/environment, registered stage manifest, current nonexpired shared clock where applicable, and one-shot stage/phase lease before dispatch or credential access
synthetic_admission: explicit fixture-only test path with temporary lease and injected MockTransport; never live credit
